retrievalProfile.description: A distressed, sepia-toned layout featuring a central portrait within a thick white border, utilizing arched slab-serif display text and organic hand-lettered subtext.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition mimicking a vintage instant photo, characterized by a desaturated sepia portrait, a heavy white border with aged textures, and a combination of rigid arched typography and loose, dark-brown hand-lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: The arched header text frames the top of the central image area.
The sepia-toned portrait contrasts against the off-white textured border.
The hand-lettered subtext at the bottom balances the heavy slab-serif header.
A central graphic icon provides a focal point between the subtext lines.
coreInvariants: Sepia or monochromatic desaturated color grading on the central image.
Thick, off-white border with visible distressing and paper texture.
Arched display text at the top of the image frame.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-shot portrait centered horizontally, leaning against a vertical surface, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The arched display text at the top serves as the primary anchor, followed by the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: starting at the arched header, moving through the portrait, and settling on the hand-lettered title and icon at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the thick white border and the dark, shadowed areas of the portrait.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the white border and dark brown text/shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and organic brush script
letterConstructionRules: Header: Arched baseline, thick uniform strokes, prominent rectangular serifs.
Subtext: Irregular heights, brush-like strokes, varying thickness, organic curves.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Header letters feature a thin internal inline or outline effect.
Subtext 'S' and 'O' have exaggerated, hand-drawn loops.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, geometric slab-serif header with a loose, organic hand-lettered footer.

avoid: Perfectly straight baselines for the footer

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight for the header.
Mimics the organic, textured feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned portrait of a man in a cowboy hat leaning against a rustic wall, placed inside a thick, distressed white polaroid-style frame with visible paper grain and dust textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched slab-serif text in the top section of the frame with a dark outline. Add hand-lettered style text at the bottom of the frame in dark brown, flanking a central stylized bird icon.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia and off-white?
Does the frame have a distressed, vintage texture?
Is the bottom text organic and hand-drawn in appearance?

adjustableVariables: Arc angle of the header text
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible paper grain in the border.
Ensure the arched text follows a smooth curve.
Verify the hand-lettered text looks manually drawn, not typed.
Confirm the sepia tones are warm and not overly grey.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Polaroid Frame + Arched Slab Serif Header + Sepia Portrait + Hand-Lettered Footer = Rustic Country Aesthetic
